source_title: EEOC What is the EEOC role in AI
unit_or_scope: Employment recruiting screening monitoring pay promotion and termination
direct_observation: AI is used across employment decisions and seemingly neutral tools can intentionally or unintentionally create disparate impact
missing_stage: named tool exposure selection rates accommodation job quality pay and remedy
next_test: trace one tool from applicant exposure through selection work quality and correction

source_title: EEOC Visual disabilities and algorithmic decision tools
unit_or_scope: Applicants and employees with visual disabilities
direct_observation: AI tools can screen out qualified people with disabilities and employers may need alternative testing or reasonable accommodation
missing_stage: whether applicants know request and receive accommodation without penalty
next_test: compare accessible and standard assessment routes and record request response and outcome

unit_or_scope: Protected groups and underserved workers in recruitment and hiring
direct_observation: Technology-related discrimination targeted ads restrictive applications and automated screening are explicit enforcement priorities
missing_stage: investigation linking tool design to named applicant or worker outcomes
next_test: select a named employer and compare selection and progression by subgroup and place

source_title: ILO AI in human resource management limits of empiricism
unit_or_scope: Recruitment compensation scheduling and performance management across workplaces
direct_observation: AI-HRM systems often rely on unclear objectives biased or incomplete data and opaque programming
closed_stage: structural risk model and human-centred governance requirement
missing_stage: firm implementation worker participation job quality and distributional outcome
next_test: audit objective data programming worker voice and outcome for one system

unit_or_scope: Qualified deaf applicant and staffing-company recruitment
direct_observation: EEOC alleges recruiting stopped after learning an interview accommodation was needed
closed_stage: named enforcement action and accommodation pathway
missing_stage: adjudicated liability remedy recurrence and automated-tool contribution
next_test: follow court outcome accommodation evidence and any broader recruitment-system effect
